values.note: ReserveAmerica, up to 9 months ahead; same-day reservations until 5 pm on the day of arrival, online or 1-800-456-2267. 'Walk-ins will not be permitted' at DEC campgrounds. A permit runs at most 14 nights, and from July 1 through Labor Day only 14 cumulative nights are allowed at any campground.

booking.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/cranberry-lake-campground/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=706 (banner: same-day until 5pm, 'Walk-ins will not be permitted'; 'up to 9 Month(s) in advance'; LENGTH OF STAY), read 2026-10-20

hookups.source: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 706 (all pages, 2026-10-20): all 165 campsites 'Electric Hookup - no', 'Full Hookup - no'

values.note: DEC says 171 campsites; ReserveAmerica lists 165 campsites and a group camp, equipment lengths 20-50 ft (43 at 40 ft, 6 at 50 ft). 'All sites are back in only and require maneuvering with the longer trailers' (one catalog entry, site 50, is typed pull-through). Sites 16, 18, 20, 24, 61 and 88 are waterfront but far or steep to the water. Some sites close for DEC's Campsite Restoration Project.

sites.source: https://dec.ny.gov/places/cranberry-lake-campground-and-day-use-area ('171 campsites') + ReserveAmerica park page (campground-specific information) and site list for parkId 706 (all pages, 2026-10-20)

facilities.source: https://dec.ny.gov/places/cranberry-lake-campground-and-day-use-area ('hot showers; flush toilets; trailer dump station') + ReserveAmerica description ('water spigots located nearby'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed $20 + $5 non-resident (DEC page), ReserveAmerica 9-month window, 14-night max. Added same-day until 5 pm, no walk-ins, no electric (catalog), 171 sites up to 50 ft, back-in only, showers/flush toilets/dump/spigots. Season left as set today from RA 2027 (May 14-Oct 10); DEC's page shows 2026 May 15-Sep 7, an early Labor Day closure for day-use-area infrastructure work. Not stated: water/sewer at sites.
